sampling: Evenly spaced by event/outcome, plus verified documentation candidates
limitations: Latest run attempt only; overwritten attempts are not reconstructed.
Markdown and docs/ci-evidence JSON are documentation; other JSON can be product code.
Unknown changed-file comparisons are not classified as docs.
Master pushes without PR metadata have an unknown source cohort.
Per-workflow listing limit is 2000; inspect coverage for larger windows.
Creation-to-start intervals may include dependency waiting; they do not isolate runner dispatch latency or prove capacity exhaustion.
p95 uses nearest rank; sparse samples often return their maximum, not a stable population tail.

comparison.method: Exact non-skipped job-name set, normalizing shard suffix only. Code cohort only. Nearest-rank p95. Latest attempts; first-attempt sensitivity included. Not causal: source, cache and runner revisions differ.

## Summary

Fixes #1634. Refs #1581, #456, #1391.

Remove nine unnecessary Linux Tier 2 serial barriers while preserving the real-time deinterlace guard. Eight tests already use process-owned resources; XSHM now changes resolution on a private Xvfb, with serial fallback when unavailable. Bound software-renderer workers to one per Linux test process. Keep the existing two-shards-per-backend CI matrix and all coverage/skip/timeout policies.

Resolve the output-delay race exposed by concurrency: publish inactive state before emitting `deactivate`. A new deterministic real-libobs callback test covers normal and forced stop; existing C test bodies and public headers are unchanged. The frontend wait logic is unchanged; its comments now describe the corrected core ordering. Feature ledger updated.

Report and all exploratory outcomes: `docs/ci-serial-audit-2026-10-21.{md,json}`. Historical unguarded timings are not final-policy or CI gate speedup claims. The landing-policy section supersedes the exploratory recommendation.

## Failures resolved

- Prior PR CI run 39658456956 failed `yadif_2x_bottom_first_50i_into_30` in OFF shard 1 despite the renderer cap. Local capped successes did not establish CI reliability. Restore only deinterlace RUN_SERIAL; retain the nine other concurrency gains.
- Output delay observed active state after deactivation. Core emitted the signal before clearing active. Fix the ordering, rather than adding a serial guard or relaxing an existing assertion. This corrects core notification ordering; it does not claim completion of #1391's separate frontend work.

## RED → GREEN

- `cb6ce6057` → `1284477b8`: generated CTest registrations require private XSHM and the removable barriers; initial RED had 17 failing assertions.
- `26818e7e8` → `066dc622f`: actual Bash environment rejects an inherited 128-worker renderer pool and pins it to one.
- `8c2f1dc7a` RED: both new callback cases fail deterministically against both backends (CTest exit 8 each). Scheduling guards also fail three assertions until timing isolation is restored.
- `6d3b3740b` GREEN: both callback cases pass 100 stop cycles each against each backend (400 total), and all 27 focused configuration/environment/shard tests pass. Earlier exploratory deinterlace-removal commits are intentionally superseded.

## Validation

Native build rebased onto `f3e6260b1`: 1,766 identical exported symbols; 64 ported C implementations excluded from hybrid libobs.

`OBS_TIER2_STAGE=test OBS_CTEST_JOBS=8 rust/tools/linux-validate/run.sh`:

| Backend | Registered | Failed | Expected skips | Execution |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| C reference (OFF) | 351 | 0 | 3 | 169.61 s |
| Hybrid (ON) | 351 | 0 | 3 | 169.20 s |

The same three unavailable PulseAudio tests skip. No original registry entries are lost; four tests arrived on master and one is the new regression. Only deinterlace retains RUN_SERIAL when Xvfb is available. All Linux registrations retain the renderer budget.

Pinned clang-format / gersemi, Bash syntax, diff checks and 27 focused Python tests pass. One primary local review found no blocking code issues; its two documentation/evidence notes are addressed. No Rust source or protocol implementation changed; runtime compatibility is checked against both backends. Full local gate not run; PR CI and merge-group CI remain the merge gates. No new workflow file or shard-count change.

Final local validation used unrestricted affinity (16 logical CPUs), unlike the four-core historical experiments. Treat it as correctness evidence, not a controlled timing comparison.

Rebased the previous head `ef33f90ddf7ed473c0a4a62c349907e570e2c1b4` onto current master at task start; retained the separate RED/GREEN commits. User explicitly requested completing and merging this optimization. Use the normal merge queue.
later_decisions.title: perf(test): remove nine serial barriers and fix output deactivation race

later_decisions.body:
## Summary

Fixes #1662. Refs #1643, #1581.

User requested unsharding after the concurrency optimization merged. Run one complete Linux Tier 2 suite per backend: two test jobs instead of four, sharing the existing native build artifact.

- Remove the shard matrix axis and both CI shard-plan/filter environment settings; each mode runs the entire CTest registry.
- Keep OFF and ON, `fail-fast: false`, Fast Gate/build dependencies, eight concurrent binaries within each suite, deinterlace RUN_SERIAL, LP_NUM_THREADS=1, private XSHM and skip/failure policy.
- Publish one uniquely named timing artifact per mode. Existing collection/merge validation and lane-proof aggregation remain intact.
- Retain optional local sharding tools. Update current tooling documentation; the historical #1643 audit remains historical. No new workflows, native test bodies, Rust source or public headers changed.

This halves test-job setup and artifact-download duplication. A full suite can take longer than one shard; no claim of shorter whole-gate time is made. The representative-day study stays under #1581.

## RED → GREEN

- `499ec7ee8` RED: the configuration contract rejects the old shard matrix (one test fails).
- `6e6e62bfa` GREEN: mode-only matrix, unfiltered suites and mode-only artifact names. 40 fanout/timing/shard/isolation/environment tests pass, plus 8 workflow duplicate-key/schedule tests.
- One primary local clud-review: clean; 9 focused fanout tests passed independently.

Full unsharded native validation on base `700aaa8b0` passed using the existing bounded Linux harness:

| Backend | Registered | Failures | Expected skips | CTest time |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| C reference (OFF) | 352 | 0 | 3 | 171.06 s |
| Hybrid (ON) | 352 | 0 | 3 | 165.77 s |

Command: `OBS_EXTRA_CMAKE_ARGS='-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER= -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=' OBS_CTEST_JOBS=8 rust/tools/linux-validate/run.sh`.

The first normal build failed through the compiler launcher with missing-source/dependency-path errors. A single rebuild with C/C++ launchers disabled succeeded, with identical 1,766 exported symbols and 68 ported C implementations excluded. No runtime test was retried or weakened. Compiler caching changes were local validation options only; this PR changes no harness/compiler flags. Both complete suites retain the same three unavailable PulseAudio skips.

Per the existing path-scope policy, workflow/ci/docs-only changes run CI/self-tests on PRs; Tier 2 runtime jobs run on relevant source changes and master. No labels or scope changes force extra jobs. PR CI and merge-group CI remain mandatory before normal queue landing.
later_decisions.title: ci: unshard Linux Tier 2 and run one complete suite per backend
